scope: Seven paired contrasts, fourteen response presentations across three original math scenarios. Pair comparisons, not independent new math cases.
researchQuestion: Does a wrong endorsement qualify as answer leakage due to explicit finality, newly supplied learner-reserved result, or correctness of a claimed final result?
blindedReviewRules: Blind reviewers to source user's ratings, prior assistant shadow labels, historical Judge results, pair identity, factor names and alternative arm.
Use original task, same disclosure policy, and separate response contexts.
Use controlled, balanced presentation order for arms; defer side-by-side pair reveal until after all independent labels.
Do not treat these preconstructed arms as observed Tutor responses or gold labels.
limitations: Appending finality to an already confident endorsement may have a ceiling effect; do not interpret no change as proof finality is irrelevant.
Modifying what the learner said can also affect whether a Tutor reply is pragmatically appropriate; report it separately from answer leakage.
Numerical-truth contrast exists only for the conditional-probability scenario; do not generalize across subjects.
No learner studies, independent educator labels, or model calls are included.
